changelog.1.0.0: Release accompanying 'Deconver for Stroke Lesion Segmentation' (SWITCH+ 2026, MICCAI)

name: Deconver for stroke lesion segmentation (ISLES'26)
task: Ischemic stroke lesion segmentation on native-space T1-weighted MRI
description: 3D segmentation of ischemic stroke lesions from T1-weighted MRI (ISLES'26 training cohort) with Deconver, nnU-Net, SegResNet and SwinUNETR-V2 trained under one fixed pipeline.
authors: Niels Vyncke, Shahryar Noei, Giuseppe Jurman, Aleksandra Pizurica, Pooya Ashtari
copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 Ghent University and Fondazione Bruno Kessler
image_classes: single-channel T1-weighted MRI, resampled to 1x1x1 mm and z-scored over non-zero voxels
intended_use: Research use only; not approved for clinical or diagnostic use.
references: Vyncke et al., Deconver for Stroke Lesion Segmentation, SWITCH+ 2026 (MICCAI)
Ashtari et al., Deconver: A Deconvolutional Network for Medical Image Segmentation, IEEE JBHI 2025
